mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_room_state (room_id, current_stage, active_member_id, action_deadline, public_data, private_data, round_number, version) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{currentStage}, #{activeMemberId}, #{actionDeadline}, #{publicData}, #{privateData}, #{roundNumber}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, current_stage, active_member_id, action_deadline, public_data, private_data, round_number, last_action_msg_id, version, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM ai_chat_room_state WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE ai_chat_room_state
current_stage = #{currentStage}, active_member_id = #{activeMemberId}, action_deadline = #{actionDeadline}, public_data = #{publicData}, private_data = #{privateData}, round_number = #{roundNumber}, last_action_msg_id = #{lastActionMsgId}, version = version + 1
WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE ai_chat_room_state
